description: This file is a Java test class for DefaultScopedConfig, testing immutability, equality, error handling, and configuration path behaviors.

classes.name: DefaultScopedConfigTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing DefaultScopedConfig's behavior, immutability, and error handling.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test configuration before all tests run.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultScopedConfig instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Ensures the equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented for DefaultScopedConfig.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullOriginalConfig
methods.description: Tests that passing null as the original Config throws the expected exception.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullConfigPath
methods.description: Tests that passing null as the config path throws the expected exception.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithMissingConfigAtConfigPath
methods.description: Tests handling of missing configuration at a specified path.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithConfigWithWrongTypeAtConfigPath
methods.description: Tests handling of a configuration value with an unexpected type at the specified path.

methods.name: getConfigPathReturnsRelativePathIfDefaultScopedConfigIsBuiltFromPlainConfig
methods.description: Verifies the config path returned when built from a plain config.

methods.name: getConfigPathReturnsAbsolutePathIfDefaultScopedConfigIsBuiltFromScopedConfig
methods.description: Verifies the config path returned when built from a scoped config.

methods.name: tryToGetMissingValue
methods.description: Tests exception handling when attempting to retrieve a missing configuration value.

methods.name: getIntValueAlthoughConfigContainsString
methods.description: Checks that an integer value is retrieved correctly even if the config contains the number as a string.
